market: Binance UM USDT perps (research); Bitget compatibility not tested

psar.projection: canonical from previously completed 4H bars only

entry_filters.low6_condition: current 4H OPEN <= min(low of previous 6 closed 4H bars) + 0.25 * previous-completed ATR14
entry_filters.crowd: at least 4 DISTINCT symbols satisfying these SAME eligibility conditions at exactly current 4H OPEN (without knowing later high/low/close)

selection.simultaneous_entry_rank: larger (PSAR_OPEN - entry_open)/ATR14 first, ties symbol ascending

exit.protective_stop: 6% below actual entry for LONG, stop-market, 15m touch research model; gap through stop exits at worse OPEN
exit.time_limit: 8 4H candles = 32 hours; exit at 4H OPEN after exactly 8 bars

risk_research.size_formula: notional / equity = min(0.25, 0.0025/(0.06 + 0.004)) = 0.0390625, also respect remaining gross cap

cost_stress: 40bp total round trip including notional cost/slippage stress; funding excluded
limitations: POSTHOC hypothesis using already-seen years; cannot infer expected future returns
Only 7 TRAIN independent events; very low signal frequency
Realized-only MDD not mark-to-market; liquidation, funding, live orderbook/slippage not simulated
Protective stop may slip beyond 6% during market gap
Not evaluated for combined LONG3 operations
No live/main/demo change approved or performed
